prototype_settings: unmodified decompose defaults: max_edit_fraction=0.15, max_indel_fraction=0.08, minimum_label_margin=2, max_candidate_alignments=250000

level_1.pass_rule: both full exact label/orientation paths RESOLVED

level_2.noise: each copy receives two deterministic substitutions plus one insertion and one deletion at fixed positions 15, 70, 40 and 60 before concatenation; B- is reverse complement before noise
level_2.pass_rule: both full expected label/orientation paths RESOLVED

level_3.source: archived Col-CEN C1/C2/C3 operational 178-bp monomer consensus; no fitted new templates
level_3.pass_rule: full exact label/orientation path RESOLVED; if not, report structural identifiability and template similarity separately

level_4.source: existing real Col-CEN C3 assembly interval with five exact equal-length structural edits and one intact control
level_4.pass_rule: 5/5 edited positives DISCORDANT and 1/1 intact SUPPORTED under the already frozen M2 route

level_5.source: existing Macadamia seven original SRA records and nine exact assembly bp edits
level_5.pass_rule: technical path decision on all cases and injected-bp edit classification; biological accuracy remains not evaluated

gate_interpretation: Level 1/2 failures indicate an algorithmic or implementation defect on easy truth; Level 1-3 success with Level 4/5 failure indicates representation/source-complexity limit; complete HOR reconstruction is not promoted unless upper levels also pass
